calculation.expression: -((R_i,20 - beta_i,60 * mean_j(R_j,20))) shifted by one completed session
calculation.description: For each tradable asset, subtract its rolling 60-session beta exposure to the equal-weight cross-asset daily market move from its trailing 20-session return, then negate the residual. Higher values indicate stronger idiosyncratic underperformance and expected reversal over the next 20 sessions. All signals are lagged one session to prevent look-ahead.

validation.universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; observation-only macro series excluded
validation.regime_notes: Positive full-history and recent 260/520-session 20-day reversal performance; recent 260-session strength remains below full-history ICIR but clears admission gates.

provenance.notes: Cross-sectional Spearman IC; dates with at least 8 valid assets included. Pairwise library correlation requires deterministic downstream audit.
